name: BootDomainSpec
purpose: Test configuration for the daemon boot/persistence assessment; not a production abstraction.

input_universe.repository: apache/maven @ 5cd1b60264101080c712accd605180a4bd9222e0, built once with -Dmaven.repo.local into RUNNER_TEMP/apache-maven-repository (outside every measurement); the daemon's m2_repo
input_universe.artifact_inventory: Every regular file under m2_repo whose name ends in .jar, except *-javadoc.jar (IndexService.scan, Files.walk without following directory links). Recorded per run in input-manifest.json with sizes; fixture-jar-sha256.txt holds content checksums.
input_universe.companions: *-sources.jar with a sibling binary: indexSources; *.jar.sha1 beside a JAR is verified before hashing it
exclusions: the workspace sources of apache/maven (no session is opened)
input_universe.stability: Input paths, mtimes and ctimes are not touched between a cold run and its paired warm run; inputs are never copied between them.

platform.jdk: Temurin 25.0.4.1+1 (sha256 dbb698396d478e7fa2b1e50f4103324b2a99b90569ee27c33f2261f9215cf41e) is the daemon's jdk_home; the product jlink image of the same build runs the daemon
platform.expected_indexing: None at native boot: IndexService.indexJdk is reached only from ensureSignatureEdges, Documentation and CodePass, all session requests. Coverage state NOT_EXERCISED_BY_NATIVE_BOOT.

configuration.launch: Product launcher equivalent: IMAGE/bin/java -XX:AOTCache=IMAGE/lib/jvmd/jvmd.aot -Xlog:aot -cp IMAGE/lib/jvmd/* dev.jvmd.dist.Application, plus -Djvmd.config/-Djvmd.state/-Djvmd.socket (isolated paths) and -Djvmd.profile.boot_events/boot_dump. The counters mode uses the full JDK of the same build (allocation counter), without the AOT cache.
configuration.environment: LANG=C.UTF-8; no network is used by the native boot path (no resolver, no session)

binary_signature_facts.owner: RocksArtifactRepository generation keyed by cacheKey(sha256, format, indexer, jdk feature, mode=signatures)
binary_signature_facts.content: symbols, binary keys, SCIP, names, owner paths, name paths, trigram postings, outgoing and reverse relationships, class references, manifest with checksum

artifact_manifests.owner: RocksIndexStore A| records (path -> key, docsKey, resolutionIdentity, counts)

documentation_members.state: REQUIRED_AND_ESTABLISHED where *-sources.jar exist; the corpus has none (see input-manifest), so the small fixture exercises it
documentation_members.owner: RocksArtifactRepository documentation generation + sources artifact manifest + U| unmatched count

repository_inventory.owner: RocksArtifactInventory P| (path, gav, kind, cacheKey, sha, stamp) and R| refcounts; scan generation numbers excluded

completeness.owner: RocksMigrationManager active.manifest + VALIDATED marker of the format generation; IndexService.repositoryReconciled()

code_body_edges.reason: CodePass/storeCode run from session requests only

global_relationship_linking.reason: RocksIndexStore.resolveGlobalRelationships is a no-op: targets stay symbolic until a workspace query

classpath_sequences_and_proofs.reason: built lazily per workspace/ClasspathContext; caches are empty without sessions (observation_caches runtime view)

local_scope.finding: TARGET GAP: local semantic restoration is demand-driven, not part of native boot.
local_scope.detail: SemanticMemoStore (local-memo-v1) is constructed without reading records; AttributedMemos, workspace bindings, LOCAL artifacts and module state are created by session.open/diagnostics.

live_scope.state: Empty in both scenarios: no session, no documents, empty unsaved-editor overlay. The file-observation journal is loaded at construction and only consulted by session requests.

required_completeness: Every binary JAR of the inventory has an artifact manifest and an immutable signature generation; every sources JAR with a binary has documentation joined; the inventory holds every path; the format generation is activated and validated; the scan recorded no artifact or source fault.
ready_predicate: DOMAIN_READY = first boot event REPOSITORY_RECONCILIATION_FINISHED with reconciled=true: emitted from the whenComplete of IndexService.start()'s readiness future after the initial scan returned with lastScanComplete (all reader futures joined, inventory completed, candidate validated/activated, removed paths reconciled, link pass returned). It carries in-flight evidence (active artifacts, reader pool, source publisher, admission and build gauges). PRODUCT_READY (stdout READY) and SESSION_CAPABLE are recorded as milestones only.

persistence_contract.metadata_store: RocksIndexStore writes with WriteOptions.setSync(true): durable before the call returns
persistence_contract.signature_and_documentation_generations: SST built in staging, fsync'd, verified, then ingested (move); RocksDB records the ingestion in its MANIFEST
persistence_contract.inventory: RocksArtifactInventory writes with default WriteOptions: WAL without sync; process-restart recoverable (WAL in the page cache), not power-loss durable
persistence_contract.activation: VALIDATED marker and active.manifest written with fsync and directory fsync, manifest by atomic rename
persistence_contract.file_observation_journal: flushed by size/age thresholds and at Application.close(); not written by native boot (no session hashes classpath files)
persistence_contract.claim_tested: process-restart recoverability at DOMAIN_READY (SIGKILL after the endpoint, warm boot from the stopped copy). Power-loss durability is not tested.
